passed.detail: Actual glebarez/go-sqlite concrete Error via errors.As; positive primary-family mask includes517, rejects LOCKED/constraint/zero/negative. Cancellation classified before BUSY; arbitrary Code interface and error text rejected.

Per-worker stage summaries mutex protected, capped64 with overflow; fixed StageEvent fields and numeric duration only. No driver error text, SQL or paths in new loser diagnostics. Worker closes every nonnil returned DB before sending one buffered terminal result.

Both ready events required before normal release. Normal path does not cancel the competition. Separate20s ready/result deadlines and10s cleanup; early failure releases then cancels. Incomplete join or close prevents directory deletion.

Only one successful initializer; losing outcome restricted to conflict/BUSY. Winner and reopen compare complete normalized sqlite_master rows with independent expected schema. Recovery pool closed before directory deletion, including nonnil DB plus error.

required_before_complete_acceptance.detail: New unit test exercises numeric classification and lookalike negatives, but not a real typed driver BUSY error or wrapped typed error. Thus the critical errors.As wiring lacks a deterministic positive regression; the dual-pool test may take the sentinel branch and never cover it.
required_before_complete_acceptance.recommendation: Add a controlled real two-connection SQLite BUSY fixture and wrapped-error assertion, plus cancellation/nil negatives. Do not construct private driver fields with unsafe or weaken to an arbitrary Code interface. This can accompany targeted validation; existing implementation is statically correct.

limitations: Worker terminal receipt proves pool Close completed, not a formal goroutine WaitGroup join; no resource work follows the terminal send. On timeout cleanup_incomplete honestly retains owned directory.
Failed OpenContext may return nil DB after its own cleanup; this test cannot independently observe every internal Close outcome. Separate startup failure/pool-close tests remain part of the evidence.
Final shared schema equality is not standalone proof of each losing transaction rollback. Retain the separate schema/trigger/index/commit failure rollback matrix.
No tests executed; historical loser category and original startup failure root cause remain unproven.
decision: No blocking implementation defect found in this scoped change. Targeted execution may proceed; close the deterministic typed-error regression gap before declaring the full test-contract acceptance complete.
